name: wix_stores-mcp
description: Wix Stores (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_wix_stores_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WIX_STORES_API_KEY
platform_mcp_wix_stores_api_key.description: Account API key from the Wix API Key Manager (account owner; Wix Stores + eCommerce scopes, site access) sent raw in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

platform_mcp_wix_stores_site_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WIX_STORES_SITE_ID
platform_mcp_wix_stores_site_id.description: Site id of the store (API keys are account-level, so every site-level call must carry the wix-site-id header).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /site-properties/v4/properties returns {properties{siteDisplayName, businessName, paymentCurrency, locale, email, ...}, version} for the site named by wix-site-id; verifies the key and the site access.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: POST /ecom/v1/orders/search {search: {filter: {status, createdDate: {$gte: since}}, cursorPaging: {limit (max 100)}}}; documented filterable fields include status, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus and createdDate ($gte...). Returns {orders[{id, number, status, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus, priceSummary{total{amount}}, currency, createdDate}], metadata{cursors, hasNext}}; `total` is a decimal string. Paging is cursor-based, so `page` is not sent (first page only). `since` (a date or datetime) is sent as an ISO dateTime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, UTC): Wix rejects a bare date with 400 INVALID_QUERY_FILTER '… is not a valid dateTime filter value' (auth audit 2026-09-26).
